Functional description

The Body Computer

M1

receives the 'door open' input signals at pin 8 (left door) and pin 25 (right door) of connector E.

The Body Computer

M1

is connected, via the CAN line, to the controls in the front door

H44

according to the control logic described previously, which supplies the two door courtesy lights

G51

and

G52

.

The unit

H44

is supplied by the line protected by fuse F39 of the underdashboard control unit

B2

.

The 'low battery voltage' signal which switches off the courtesy lights if they are on, always arrives via the CAN

See E1050 CAN CONNECTION LINES

.
